name: Extremely Cold Condensed Milk Scented Tea

pages.text: $(#87CEEB)❄️ Frost Essence Condensation · Ice Armor Holy Drink 🥛$()$(br2)$(l)$(#4682B4)「Sacrificing speed in exchange for an absolute defense unshaken even by avalanches」$()$(br)The extreme cold essence of $(#87CEEB)Millennium Snow Lotus$(), the flexibility of $(#B0E0E6)Frostfield Condensed Milk$(), the biting chill of $(#00BFFF)Eternal Ice Core$(), and the resilience of $(#DAA520)Rock Honey Gel$() are fused under low temperatures within the $(#483D8B)Cold Iron Cauldron$()—an ancient mountain tribe ritual capable of $(l)temporarily transforming flesh into crystalline ice armor$().

$(#00BFFF)▌ Frost Balance $()$(br2)$(l)$(#696969)⛓ Frostbound Shackles$()$(br)Feet encased in $(#87CEEB)frost chains$() while moving.$(br2)$(l)$(#4682B4)🛡 Eternal Frozen Armor$()$(br)A layer of $(#00CED1)blue diamond ice$() forms over the body, absorbing immense damage.$(br2)$(l)$(#87CEEB)❄ Snow Feather Descent$()$(br)Falling is slowed as $(#E0FFFF)gentle snowflakes$() swirl around.

$(br2)$(#483D8B)▌ Frostborne Crafting $()$(br)- Use a $(#87CEEB)sharp blade$() to shave $(#00BFFF)ice blocks$() into $(#B0E0E6)snowflake-like crystals$().$(br)- Soak $(#87CEEB)Snow Lotus$() in $(#DAA520)honey$() under $(#4682B4)low temperatures$() for three days and nights.$(br)- When mixing $(#B0E0E6)condensed milk$(), ensure the environment remains $(#00BFFF)below freezing$().$(br2)$(#7FFFD4)※$() A successful brew will display $(#87CEEB)fractured ice patterns$() and emit $(#E0FFFF)frost mist$().

$(br2)$(#2F4F4F)『 Forbidden Record of the Aurora Palace 』$()$(br)An inscription found on an ancient frost monolith:$(br)'Those who drink this $(#87CEEB)Frost Essence Elixir$(),$(br)shall inherit the $(#4682B4)resilience of the Ice Giants$() and the $(#00CED1)gentle descent of the Snow Owl$()—$(br)but $(#696969)each step$() must break through the $(#87CEEB)Shackles of Ice$(),$(br)as a necessary punishment decreed by the $(#483D8B)Snow Queen$() upon those who dare $(#DAA520)steal divine power$().'
